title: Digital templates on Etsy
one_liner: Make a template once and sell it as an instant download again and again.
followers: None. Buyers find you through Etsy search.
pay: On a $10 sale you keep about $8.60 after Etsy's main fees (US).
steps: Pick one narrow template type (planner, rate card, resume).
Make it in Canva or Google Slides and export a download file.
List it with clear photos and keywords buyers search for.
Add one new template a week and improve the ones that sell.
catch: Etsy charges $0.20 per listing, a 6.5% transaction fee and payment processing of about 3% + $0.25 per sale (US). Popular niches are crowded.

match.first_step: Make one simple template and list it for $0.20.
